The frozen js target keeps vanilla lighting (NOT_APPLICABLE for js).

Owner approval, 2026-11-02: a respawn (ServerPlayer.adjustSpawnLocation, also the End exit) runs vanilla's spawn search again. The browser findSpawn used to return the world spawn as is, which the browser setInitialSpawn stores at the top of the level, so every respawn landed at y=320 and the player fell to death in a loop. The digest change is the two injected methods: gaius$findSpawnNow (vanilla findSpawn with scheduleNext replaced) and gaius$searchNow (vanilla's candidate order run to completion on the calling thread, same candidates and same fixupSpawnHeight fallback). A joining player keeps the deferred path through the gaius$deferSpawnSearch flag that PrepareSpawnTask.start sets around its orElseGet. GaiusRespawnSearchFixture checks both paths on every profile and target.
